description: Source code for a command-line help utility class 'HelpCommand' that provides help text and command listing for a tool, including handling options and command execution.

classes.name: HelpCommand
classes.description: A command class that provides help and command listing functionalities for a tool.

methods.name: help_epilog
methods.description: Generates and returns the help epilog string, listing commands based on the show_all_commands flag.

methods.name: _remove_help_options
methods.description: Removes help options from the option parser to prevent them from being shown as global options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command, printing help or specific command help based on arguments.
